queries.query: LLM network configuration generation "large language model" "network configuration" "NetOps"
queries.rationale: Locate direct work on using LLMs to generate/configure network devices, intent-to-configuration translation, and examples of generated configs.
Find literature documenting hallucination-type errors when LLMs produce actionable outputs that cause misconfiguration or incorrect operational actions.

queries.query: intent-to-configuration translation "intent driven" "network configuration" natural language to config
queries.rationale: Survey methods and evaluations for translating high-level operator intent into device-specific configuration (mapping, templates, synthesis).

queries.query: network configuration verification Batfish Veriflow "reachability" "policy compliance"
queries.rationale: Collect literature and tool docs on deterministic/network verification (Batfish, Veriflow, Anteater) to serve as validators or oracles for generated configs.
Locate architectures combining generation, automated validation, and repair loops (for LLMs or structured-output models) applicable to NetOps.

queries.query: tool-augmented LLMs for operations "tool use" LLM "AIOps" "toolformer"
queries.rationale: Find work on LLMs augmented with external tools (parsers, simulators, verifiers) and how tool calls affect reliability in operational tasks.

queries.query: constrained generation schema-guided structured output LLM "constrained decoding" "schema"
queries.rationale: Survey constrained generation techniques (CFGs, schema constraints, constrained decoding) to reduce syntactic and semantic config errors.

queries.query: formal methods for network configurations SMT Z3 verification "ACL" "reachability"
queries.rationale: Identify formal-methods approaches (SMT, model checking) for proving properties of configurations and potential for automatic validators.

queries.query: LLM self-correction iterative repair "self-correction" "self-repair" language models
queries.rationale: Gather evidence on LLM self-revision strategies and their empirical success/failure modes, relevant to iterative config repair loops.

queries.query: evaluation metrics for configuration correctness "reachability" "connectivity" "policy compliance"
queries.rationale: Discover domain-appropriate metrics for measuring syntactic correctness, semantic correctness, functional correctness, and safety of configs.
Locate existing benchmarks, tasks, and datasets used to evaluate AIOps/NetOps and assess suitability and limitations for LLM-driven experiments.

queries.query: simulators and testbeds for network experiments "Mininet" "ns-3" "GNS3" "Emulab"
queries.rationale: Identify simulation/emulation platforms suitable for evaluating functional correctness of generated configurations and for fault injection.

queries.query: adversarial evaluation LLMs operations stress tests "adversarial" "stress test" LLM
queries.rationale: Find methods and studies that apply adversarial or stress-testing evaluation to reveal brittleness and worst-case failure modes.

queries.query: prompt injection and prompt vulnerability "prompt injection" "security" LLM
queries.rationale: Collect literature on prompt-injection attacks and risk of LLMs being steered to unsafe or incorrect operations in NetOps workflows.
Survey calibration and confidence-estimation methods for LLM outputs to evaluate whether model confidence can indicate config correctness.

queries.query: automated network configuration repair "configuration repair" "self healing" "auto fix" network
queries.rationale: Find prior work on automated detection and repair of misconfigurations independent of LLMs, to adapt repair algorithms or baselines.

queries.query: agentic AI for operations "autonomous agent" "LLM agent" NetOps "AutoGPT" "LangChain"
queries.rationale: Survey agent frameworks and orchestration approaches used to create multi-step agentic workflows in operations contexts and their governance mechanisms.

queries.query: case studies LLMs in production operations "case study" "LLM" "operations"
queries.rationale: Locate real-world or experimental case studies of LLMs used in operational settings to understand deployment hazards and mitigations.

queries.query: construct validity benchmarks evaluation design "construct validity" "benchmark validity" LLM tasks
queries.rationale: Find methodological literature on benchmark design and construct validity to inform how to build/assess NetOps evaluations that map to operational properties.

inclusion_criteria: Primary sources (peer-reviewed papers, arXiv preprints, official tool/project documentation) with verifiable bibliographic metadata
Publicly accessible artifacts (code, datasets, tool docs) or clear pointers to stable repositories
Work that directly addresses LLMs/LLM-agents applied to NetOps or presents validators/simulators/benchmarks usable for evaluating generated network actions
Studies with explicit experimental methods, metrics, or failure analyses that can inform reproducible design
Papers in English or with reliable English translations
exclusion_criteria: Non-technical marketing materials or blog posts lacking verifiable technical detail (unless they link to primary artifacts)
Proprietary internal reports without accessible methods or data
Opinion pieces or editorials without empirical/technical content
Duplicate versions of the same work (keep the canonical peer-reviewed version or arXiv/tech-report primary source)
Works solely about unrelated application domains unless methods are directly transferable to NetOps
date_rationale: Prioritize literature from 2020–present for LLM- and agent-specific developments; include 2010–present for foundational NetOps verification, simulators, and configuration-repair literature. Include older seminal formal-methods or verification works as necessary for context.
